item.case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
item.group_name: How the conversation goes (applies on top of any case above)
item.title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget

turns.text: Make a silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream. The estimate shown is 90 credits, but my hard limit is 30. If it's over, stop—don't make anything.

item.tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

answer_sheet.Requested clip: A silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream.
answer_sheet.Estimate and budget: The displayed estimate is 90 credits; the hard budget is 30 credits.
answer_sheet.What to do over budget: Stop without generating anything or substituting a cheaper version.

must_haves: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
The response clearly says generation has not started.
No clip or substitute asset is delivered.

turns.text: Make a silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream. The estimate shown is 90 credits, but my hard limit is 30. If it's over, stop—don't make anything.

dialog.agent: The shown estimate is **90 credits**, which exceeds your **30-credit hard limit**. I won’t start the generation; nothing has been created or spent.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

dialog.agent: Do you want to lift your **30-credit hard limit** and authorize the **90-credit estimate**, or keep the limit? I won’t start a potentially over-budget generation without your confirmation.
dialog.user: Keep the 30-credit hard limit; I’m not authorizing the 90-credit estimate. Since that’s over budget, stop without generating anything or substituting a cheaper version. The clip I requested was silent, five seconds long, and widescreen.

turns.agent: Understood. I won’t generate the silent, 5-second widescreen clip or substitute a cheaper version. No generation was started, and no credits were spent.

plan.say: Understood. I won’t generate the silent, 5-second widescreen clip or substitute a cheaper version. No generation was started, and no credits were spent.
